spans.s:
gáṇa-ka, m. reckoner;
 astrologer.

gaṇa-dīkṣin, a. officiating for 🞄a community (priest);
 -dravya, n. property 🞄of a corporation.
gaṇa-vṛtta, n. metre measured by 🞄feet.
gaṇaśás, ad. by or in troops.

gaṇa‿īśa, m. chief of Śivaʼs attendants, 🞄Gaṇeśa, god of wisdom, remover of obstacles, 🞄son of Śiva and Pārvatī;
 also ep. of Śiva.

gāṇeśa, a. relating to Gaṇeśa;
 🞄worshipper of Gaṇeśa.
gaṇḍ-u, pillow.
gaṇḍū-pada, m. kind of worm.

gaṇḍa‿upadhāna, n. pillow: 🞄ī-ya, n. id.;
 -upala, m. large boulder.

gaṇ-ya, fp. to be counted, calculated, 🞄or regarded;
 a. consisting of rows.

gā́ṇa-patya, a. relating to Gaṇeśa;
 🞄m. worshipper of Gaṇeśa.
gāṇḍiva, m. n. Arjunaʼs bow: 🞄-dhara, m. ep. of Arjuna.

gāṇḍīva, m. Arjunaʼs bow;
 -dhanvan, m. Arjuna.
